summary: Comprehensive testing of Turkish restaurant/cafe menu management system completed. All major features working correctly including admin registration/login, category/product CRUD, QR code generation, public menu display, and theme switching.

design_issues.issue: Empty state message not displayed when no categories exist (minor issue)

passed_tests: Backend API - All 17 endpoints (100% success rate)
Admin registration with unique email validation
Category CRUD operations (create, read, update, delete)
Menu item CRUD operations with optional photos
QR code page with download functionality
Public menu display with category navigation
Light/dark theme toggle on all pages
Turkish language and special character support
Edit functionality for categories and items

success_percentage.frontend: 95% (1 minor UI issue with empty state display)
